name: What sets the period of SHM
summary: Period depends on the restoring system (length and g, or k and m), not on amplitude for small swings.

name: Motion and energy in SHM
summary: Acceleration is greatest at the extremes, speed greatest at the centre; energy goes as amplitude squared.

name: Waves are chained SHM
summary: Each particle does SHM in place; the medium sets the speed, the source sets the frequency, v = f lambda.

name: Superposition and beats
summary: Waves add point by point; two close frequencies give beats at |f1 - f2|.

name: Plane mirrors
summary: The image is as far behind the mirror as the object is in front, and the visible portion does not depend on distance.

name: Curved mirrors
summary: Where the object sits relative to F and C decides whether a concave mirror forms a real or virtual image.

name: Refraction and lenses
summary: Light bends towards the normal entering a denser medium; every part of a lens forms the whole image.

name: Interference: double slit
summary: Coherent waves from two slits make fringes of width beta = lambda D / d; dark fringes are cancellation.

name: Diffraction
summary: A single slit spreads light into a central band of width 2 lambda D / a; narrower slits spread more.
